_comment: Canonical PasskeyChallenge document shape. client is the authority - it stores ephemeral WebAuthn/FIDO2 challenge data in this collection during passkey authentication ceremonies. Challenges are short-lived and cleared on completion or expiry. A field mismatch breaks passkey authentication flows.

passkey_challenge._description: Ephemeral WebAuthn challenge document. Created at the start of a passkey authentication ceremony and deleted on completion or expiry. Used to store the challenge bytes and associated user context between the challenge and verification steps.

id.description: Challenge identifier. Typically a UUID v4 or the base64url-encoded challenge string.

user_id.description: User ID the challenge is for. Null for registration ceremonies where the user may not exist yet.

ceremony_type.description: WebAuthn ceremony type. See status.json auth.ceremony.

options.description: Serialized WebAuthn CredentialCreationOptions or CredentialRequestOptions. Shape matches the go-webauthn protocol types.

expires_at.description: When the challenge expires. Challenges are invalid after this time.

completed.description: Whether the ceremony was completed. Set to true on successful verification.

created_at.description: When the challenge was created (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z suffix).
